statement.description: You are given two positive integers $ a $ and $ b $ . In one move you can increase $ a $ by $ 1 $ (replace $ a $ with $ a+1 $ ). Your task is to find the minimum number of moves you need to do in order to make $ a $ divisible by $ b $ . It is possible, that you have to make $ 0 $ moves, as $ a $ is already divisible by $ b $ . You have to answer $ t $ independent test cases.
statement.formatI:
The first line of the input contains one integer $ t $ ( $ 1 \le t \le 10^4 $ ) — the number of test cases. Then $ t $ test cases follow.

The only line of the test case contains two integers $ a $ and $ b $ ( $ 1 \le a, b \le 10^9 $ ).
statement.formatO: For each test case print the answer — the minimum number of moves you need to do in order to make $ a $ divisible by $ b $ .

translation.description: 给定两个正整数 $a$ 和 $b$。每次操作你可以将 $a$ 增加 $1$（即用 $a+1$ 替换 $a$）。你的任务是求出最少需要多少次操作才能使 $a$ 能被 $b$ 整除。如果 $a$ 已经能被 $b$ 整除，则可能不需要进行任何操作。你需要回答 $t$ 个独立的测试用例。
translation.formatI: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$），表示测试用例的数量。接下来有 $t$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $a$ 和 $b$（$1 \le a, b \le 10^9$）。
translation.formatO: 对于每个测试用例，输出一个答案，即使 $a$ 能被 $b$ 整除所需的最少操作次数。
